vision.tone: Plain, patient and close: two people talking at a diner counter and booth in early light, the turns carried by faces and small pauses, never by speeches or camera tricks.
references: an empty diner at dawn seen at standing and seated eye level, cool window light warming through the morning
a low-key negotiation drama played in pauses and glances

visual_rules.rule: Static eye-level camera, no dutch angles, no handheld shake.
visual_rules.why: The turn comes from Ruth's face and Sam's answer, not from the camera.

visual_rules.rule: Keep Ruth screen-left and Sam screen-right in every shot of the counter and the booth.
visual_rules.why: The distance between them stays readable and the cut never flips who is where.

visual_rules.rule: One person moves or handles one prop at a time, never together; no hand-over and no contact.
visual_rules.why: Hands on small props and two bodies in contact are the least reliable things the video model does (film01, film04).

visual_rules.rule: Singles keep the counter edge or the high red booth back in frame.
visual_rules.why: film05: a close single at table height reads as standing or seated by chance; the furniture makes posture readable.

visual_rules.rule: The closure notice and the OPEN card are static graphics composited and checked in post.
visual_rules.why: Generated text on a prop cannot be trusted to read correctly.

facts.text: A printed notice says the diner is closing permanently

carriers.detail: It says permanently. That's quite a word to leave out.

facts.text: The closure notice was printed before Ruth offered Sam the job

carriers.detail: Yes. It was already here when we talked that night.

facts.text: Ruth planned this as one last proper morning before closing

carriers.detail: One proper morning. Before I put that thing on display.

facts.text: Ruth cannot open and close everything alone any more

carriers.detail: I can still do the work. I can't do all of it.

facts.text: The diner will open as a two-seat counter with coffee and toast

carriers.detail: Then two seats hold. I can live with two seats.

facts.text: There is a fixed wage reserve for the trial week, 225 dollars

carriers.detail: Two hundred twenty five. Paid each morning, not after Friday.

facts.text: Sam and Ruth agree five paid mornings and a decision after the trial

carriers.detail: Five mornings, counting today. Six until nine, fifteen an hour.
At the end, we decide whether another week makes sense.

facts.text: The diner puts up an OPEN card; the trial begins

carriers.detail: There's a little note card by the register. Use that one.
